summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Edward Reilly was taken to the Dispensary with severe head injuries, saying Tom Allen, the Market Street saloon-keeper and prize-fighter, had slugged him without provocation; his skull was thought fractured.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Monday, October 13, 1890, page 4.

facts.fact: Edward Reilly said Allen slugged him without provocation, leaving him with severe head injuries and a suspected fractured skull; Reilly was sent to the hospital

notes: Reilly's accusation only; no arrest or response from Allen is reported. Event was 'yesterday', i.e. Sunday, October 12, 1890.
